_comments: THE RENEWAL CHARGE ACTION (#289). Its own dot-json so parallel work on other actions conflicts on nothing.
WHY AN ACTION. A renewal falls due with nothing being written, so only the clock can start the charge;
MJ's scheduler dispatches Actions, and this row is how the daily job reaches ChargeRenewals. The class
behind it holds no charging logic.
SAFE TO SHIP Active: nothing invokes it until the ScheduledJob in metadata/scheduled-jobs/ is enabled,
and that job ships Disabled and set to Preview.

fields.Name: Charge Renewals
fields.Description: Charge the renewal card of each renewal order due a charge today: on its due day (the new term's first day), then on the retry days after it (the RenewalChargeRetryDays setting, default 3, 7 and 11), until it is paid or reaches the access cutoff. A success is captured against the order; a decline or an authentication demand is recorded as a failed attempt with the next attempt day. Preview reports what would be charged without charging.
fields.UserPrompt: Charge the saved cards of renewal orders due a charge today, or preview what would be charged.

fields.Name: AsOfDate
fields.Description: Treat this date as today when deciding which renewal orders are due a charge (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the business day, which is what the schedule uses. An unreadable value is refused rather than replaced with today.

fields.Name: SubscriptionID
fields.Description: Restrict the pass to the renewal orders of one subscription, for a targeted retry or a test. Omit for every subscription with a renewal card.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True reports what WOULD be charged and charges nothing; false (the default) charges. A value that is neither is refused rather than guessed.

fields.Name: MaxCount
fields.Description: Cap on orders charged in one pass. Orders left over are charged on the next pass if the day is still a charge day. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused.

fields.Name: Charged
fields.Description: How many renewal orders this pass paid from the renewal card (or would, on a preview).

fields.Name: Failed
fields.Description: How many charges the gateway declined or that needed the customer to authenticate.

fields.Name: Skipped
fields.Description: How many renewal orders were looked at and not charged today, each with its reason in Attempts.

fields.Name: Attempts
fields.Description: Every renewal order looked at: the subscription, the amount, the due day, the attempt number, the outcome, the reason, the intent and payment, and the next attempt day after a failure.

fields.Name: Failures
fields.Description: Orders whose attempt hit a fault, with the error. The rest of the pass stands.

fields.Name: PreviewedOnly
fields.Description: True when this pass reported its list and charged nothing. Not named Preview, so the input's value is not overwritten.
